content.title: Alaska Air Cuts Profit Outlook As Fuel Costs Jump And IT Outage Hits
content.summary: Alaska Air Group Inc. (NYSE:ALK) said Monday it expects third-quarter adjusted earnings per share to come in at the low end of its prior $1.00 to $1.40 forecast, as higher fuel prices and operational issues weighed on results. Refinery disruptions on the West Coast lifted the airline’s expected fuel cost to $2.50 to $2.55 per gallon, above its earlier estimate of about $2.45. content.title: Alaska Air warns that third-quarter income will be at low end of guidance
content.summary: Investing.com - Alaska Air has warned that third-quarter adjusted earnings per share will be at the low end of its previously guided forecast range of $1.00 to $1.40, flagging the impact of high fuel costs and summertime "operational challenges."

content.title: Alaska Air estimates third-quarter profit at low end of forecast on fuel costs
content.summary: -Alaska Air expects its quarterly profit to be at the low end of its previous forecast, as high fuel costs and operational challenges weigh on margins, the U.S. carrier said on Monday.  Alaska now expects to pay up to $2.55 per gallon, up from its earlier projections of about $2.45 per gallon.  Alaska also flagged weather and air traffic control issues driving up costs such as passenger compensation and crew overtime expenses.

content.title: Low Cost Airlines Struggle While Legacy Rivals Soar On Global Travel Rebound
